summary: The same news pipeline with a unique source_id, an index on the pending predicate, progress marked by primary key and a direct legacy key lookup.

must_not_flag.contains: UPDATE articles SET embedded_at = ? WHERE id = ?
must_not_flag.reason: Progress is written to the rows the job selected, so the pending set drains and each run does only new work.
source_id is unique, so re-polling the feed adds only new items.
A legacy key costs one KV read, whatever the number of legacy keys.
